summary.ru: Народная Республика Занзибара и Пембы — государство на территории бывшего Султаната Занзибар, существовавшее с 12 января по 26 апреля 1964 года.
summary.en: The People's Republic of Zanzibar was a short-lived African state founded in 1964, consisting of the islands of the Zanzibar Archipelago. It existed for less than six months before it merged with Tanganyika to create the "United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar", which would be renamed the United Republic of Tanzania in November of that year.
